item.sophisticated_redox.oxidation_upgra: Oxidises copper blocks one stage further when stored in the rucksack
item.sophisticated_redox.advanced_oxidat: Oxidises copper blocks all the way to the oxidised stage when stored in the rucksack
item.sophisticated_redox.reduction_upgra: Scrapes one oxidation stage off copper blocks when stored in the rucksack
item.sophisticated_redox.advanced_reduct: Scrapes copper blocks back to the unaffected stage when stored in the rucksack
Waxes copper blocks when stored in the rucksack, locking them at their current stage. Always runs after the oxidation and reduction upgrades
gui.sophisticated_redox.button.dewax.on: Dewaxing allowed - dewaxing counts as one step, the remaining steps reduce
gui.sophisticated_redox.button.dewax.off: Dewaxing blocked - waxed blocks are left alone
gui.sophisticated_redox.button.shape_mat: Shape match on - the filter matches every oxidation stage and waxed variant of the same shape
Shape match off - the filter matches exact items
